title: Fentanyl is a WMD Act
latestAction: Referred to the Subcommittee on Emergency Management and Technology.
summary:
Fentanyl is a WMD Act

This bill requires the Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office of the Department of Homeland Security to treat illicit fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction.

actions.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Emergency Management and Technology.
